summary: Describes how to handle internationalized email when a server along the path cannot cope with UTF-8 in addresses and headers, instead of rejecting the message. It defines a downgrading mechanism for the experimental UTF8SMTP extension. It was replaced by RFC 6530.

eli5.summary: Some mail servers only understand plain English letters. This note describes how to convert a message with other alphabets so it can still travel through them, rather than being thrown away.
